verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Follow Up Boss accepting natural-language commands, such as an in-app assistant, chat interface or conversational agent. The evidence covers only a REST API, docs published as llms.txt and markdown, and conventional automation features (Action Plans, Automations). Those are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not natural-language operation of the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
